title: Senior Controls Engineer
intro: A leading systems integrator in Telford is looking for a Senior Controls Engineer to design and deliver control systems from concept through to site acceptance. Reporting to the Controls Manager, you will turn client requirements into robust designs and software, and help develop less experienced engineers.
bullets: Understand client requirements and produce electrical and controls concept designs
Hand over to the hardware design team and review the designs produced
Design and produce software for PLC, HMI, SCADA, robot and drive systems
Carry out Factory Acceptance Testing, commissioning and Site Acceptance Testing
Maintain the Technical Construction File and mentor less experienced engineers
outro: This form takes around 15 minutes. Specific examples help us put the strongest candidates forward.

about.label: Where do you live, and roughly how long would your journey to Telford take?
about.sheet: Home location and journey time to Telford
about.hint: For example: TF3, about 15 minutes by car

about.label: Do you have the right to work in the UK?
about.sheet: Right to work in the UK

about.sheet: Comfortable with site work and travel

questions.label: Which best describes your current or most recent role?

also: This role would also suit New Product Design Engineers, Electrical Design Engineers and Automation Engineers with strong controls software experience.
